result.summary: Found 1 visible layout issue: one restaurant card has cramped text that appears to overlap, reducing readability.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line under the title appears visually compressed and partially overlaps, making the delivery time and details hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase vertical spacing or allow the metadata line to wrap cleanly so the text does not collide or appear clipped.
